notes.grid: cell-center; voxel i center = origin + (i+0.5)*pitch; z origin = 0
notes.free_epsilon: free = z < depth - free_epsilon_m (1 mm declared sensor/registration noise). Front error bound = free_epsilon_m + pitch/2 = 3.5 mm at 5 mm pitch, which is below the frozen 5 mm freespace tolerance.
notes.band: measurement band = [depth - free_epsilon_m, depth + band_m]; band_m >= pitch - free_epsilon_m is enforced so every valid mask column has at least one constrained solid cell (no gaps in the visible surface).
notes.depth: axis depth positive_camera_minus_z, same as align/freespace
notes.depth_edges: Tested: excluding depth-discontinuity pixels from free-space and shell constraints made freespace_violation worse (0.1213 -> 0.3714 at 5 mm) because parent geometry survives at the silhouette; the flag stays available but is disabled for the frozen formal config.
